candidate.title: Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to Paperclip server .env and restart — unblocks SAG-1318 smoke test
candidate.description:
Blocked on SAG-1328 — CEO must provision the key value first.

The Paperclip server does not have ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in its environment. The claude-local adapter reads this from process.env directly.
